speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 36.8°C (98°F), Blood Pressure 135/85 mmHg, Heart Rate 82 bpm, Respiratory Rate 14 breaths/min. Kidney Examination: Mild to moderate tenderness on right flank palpation; Positive Costovertebral angle tenderness on the right side; Abdomen soft and non-distended. Urinalysis: Appearance Reddish, WBC 10-20 /HPF, RBC Too numerous to count, Nitrites Negative, Leukocyte Esterase Positive. Blood Work: Creatinine 1.1 mg/dL, BUN 14 mg/dL, Complete Blood Count Within normal limits. Imaging (Intravenous Pyelogram): Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla; No obstruction noted.

speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging results showing multiple cysts in the collecting ducts of the medulla, combined with your recurrent UTIs and hematuria, are highly specific. This presentation is characteristic of Medullary Sponge Kidney. DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney.
